layout.safe_zones: top ~4% and bottom ~6% reserved for YouTube chrome; content is a static full-bleed infographic poster occupying whole 9:16 frame
layout.caption_pos: center-low third, on a dark semi-transparent rounded chip, one short phrase at a time

transitions: none — single static poster image + simulated stylus/finger annotation drawing (circles, arrows, underlines) over ~70s, then hard cut to a separate dark countdown-timer card for last ~15s

themeable: accent color pair (accent/accent2) — swap per channel brand
outro countdown card colors (bg/accent) and CTA copy
icon set style (line-icon glyphs) — can be swapped for a different icon family keeping same grid
